mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.created_at FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.resource, p.action, p.created_at FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN roles r ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
